cases.setup: Disposable Node repository with a deterministic off-by-one pagination failure and an independent passing module.
cases.prompt: Use AE to fix the pagination boundary and verify it. Preserve the independent module.
acceptance: Fix the independently checked failing case
Use the smallest workflow
No unnecessary full team or repeated confirmation
Report actual checks

cases.setup: Disposable repository with an approved plan for two file-disjoint modules and their tests, explicit no shared resources, and a dependent integration test.
cases.prompt: Use AE to implement the approved plan with independent units in parallel, then integrate and verify.
acceptance: Observe concurrent worker execution when slots exist
Exclusive writes and preserved inputs
Integration starts only after independently verified prerequisites
Report actual model and role dispatch

cases.setup: Three units: two touch different files but share a write resource api:items, and one independent resource. A dependent test exposes inconsistent producer/consumer contracts.
cases.prompt: Use AE to implement the approved plan. Coordinate the shared API while allowing independent work to progress.
acceptance: Serialize the conflicting resource
Do not globally serialize the independent unit
Validate final producer/consumer agreement
Do not release a failed dependency

cases.setup: Disposable Git repository with hashed unrelated user edits and an untracked file, plus an approved independent two-unit plan.
cases.prompt: Use AE to execute the approved plan and preserve all my existing work.
acceptance: Preserve user file bytes
Inspect baseline ownership without a blanket clean-tree block
No unauthorized Git operations
Escalate any unresolved actual overlap

cases.setup: Disposable service fixture with lazy synthetic rows, page and concurrency limits, independently instrumented live-record/query counters, and a full-fetch-then-page defect.
cases.prompt: Use AE to repair the data path so memory and concurrency stay bounded while preserving filters, totals and transaction semantics.
acceptance: No full-fetch/collect-before-chunk workaround
Peak live records and in-flight work fit the fixture limits
Query counts and expected IDs/totals agree
Do not claim production heap or throughput proof
